finding: Y&F Srl / YOUR FILL is independently confirmed by current first-party material as a CPO, not merely a historical PUN legal label. Y&F states CPO registration number 1223445 and public charging infrastructure operation. The current YourFill application exposes the tariff applicable to each selected charging point and supports station discovery by QR code or station ID. This is positive evidence for a deterministic station-level resolution path, but not evidence for a single network-wide tariff. Therefore Y&F must remain a valid unresolved current-PUN identity candidate and, once its current partyId is mapped, should be classified station-level unless a first-party global tariff grid is subsequently proven.
